model.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Diarization
model.training: Official pretrained checkpoint; no claim of retraining the foundation model. AMI was included in pretraining.

runtime.license: Apache-2.0; dependencies retain their upstream licenses
runtime.execution: Native C++ worker with CPU or CUDA backends; no Python runtime inference.

fusion.mapping: Acoustic clusters map independently to the neural channel with greatest shared activity. Multiple acoustic clusters may map to one persistent identity.
fusion.assignment: Inside acoustic speech regions, prefer active neural channels. Otherwise complete from anchored acoustic labels. Unanchored clusters abstain.

segmentation.selection: Joint development selection across v3-streaming and v3-offline, frozen before the existing IS1009a integrations.

live.acoustic_execution: One background task; the neural cache continues advancing while acoustic evidence is computed.
live.wire_protocol: Little-endian uint32 sample count followed by float32 PCM; zero count flushes the stream. One newline JSON update per request.
live.activity_scores: Mean of the latest ten neural frames. These are uncalibrated activity scores, not identity probabilities.

recordings.selection: Lower joint-development DER than v3-streaming; the preset still uses the persistent cache.

activation: Automatic when both pinned native backends and the GGUF model are available and the speaker-count control is Auto. Fixed speaker counts retain the legacy constrained clustering path.
limitations: At most eight neural speaker channels; the integration recordings contain four speakers.
Short, quiet or similar voices can merge or be missed; identity labels remain provisional.
AMI checks are previously observed integrations and overlap with model pretraining, not independent generalization evidence.
After the upstream probability compaction horizon, finalized older segments use upstream default segmentation settings; the retained tail uses the selected settings.
